assessment_basis: Static review of the repository README and linked feature, architecture or roadmap documentation. Source-level deep audit and CI/test rerun were not performed for this adoption.

evidence.claim: The feature matrix documents an offline generator, DSP routing, manifest exchange, plugin catalogue and bounded analysis.
The C++20 renderer, Qt desktop, stochastic router, Quantum DSP kernels, plugin host, manifests and tests are mapped as an integrated system.

limitations: The audio pipeline is offline and does not claim real-time DAW hosting or physical audio-device access.
No test or CI workflow was re-run during ladder adoption.
next_gate: Verify deterministic golden renders across the declared platform matrix.
Stress plugin lifecycle, malformed inputs and DSP boundary behavior with repeatable tests.
Record resource/performance budgets and version-compatibility evidence.
